mandate: The dare: pick a small fight with the fizzy aisle, from the point of view of someone who gave up soda.

default.headline: A better alternative to soda

headline: For when water is too polite and soda is too much.
image_prompt: One glass bottle alone on a bare kitchen counter at dusk, lit only by an open fridge, long shadow, quiet and a little funny, the top of the frame left calm and empty
why: Our audience gave up soda and misses the bite. Naming the gap between water and soda speaks to that moment directly, with a wink.
